rewrites.comment: OAuth discovery for the MCP server. MUST precede the SPA catch-all — rewrites match in order, and `**` would otherwise answer these with index.html, which is exactly what it did before this existed. Served by a function rather than from public/.well-known/, because the ignore rule `**/.*` above drops dot-directories from the deploy without saying so.

headers.comment: Default: always revalidate, so a new deploy is picked up immediately. This MUST be `**` rather than `/index.html` — header rules match the path the browser REQUESTED, not the rewrite destination, and no real visitor ever requests `/index.html`. They request `/` or an SPA route (`/p/:id`, `/login`, `/join/…`), all of which merely rewrite to index.html and so previously fell through to Hosting's default `max-age=3600` — leaving returning users on the previous bundle for up to an hour after every deploy. Overridden for hashed assets below.

Content-hashed build assets (JS/CSS/fonts) are immutable — cache them for a year so repeat visits don't re-download the vendor chunks or fonts. Must stay AFTER the `**` rule: every matching rule is applied in order, so the last one to set Cache-Control wins.
